items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And maybe a guy like Half-Pint, he used to jump up there in front of the band, and clown and direct the band, that's about all.

ctx.x: But you know Charlie Johnson had a habit of getting up from his piano, and going out maybe somewhere, leave the band playing without a piano and he was the first one to do that and the band played very well without him. He'll do that all the time. Get up and leave the band. He'd go home, or go out and sit down, listen to his band. His band played very well without him. And maybe a guy like Half-Pint, he used to jump up there in front of the band, and clown and direct the band, that's about all.
Uh-huh. What would you say was the -- back then, in your early days in the '20's. What were the great events in your life?
